note: Every file here was written at the moment it describes. Nothing in this directory is reconstructed after the fact; if a session produced no evidence of something, there is no file for it.

captures.shows: The machine with no Salesforce tooling on it: node and npm versions, and `which sf` returning nothing. The last moment this state existed.
npm install -g @salesforce/cli, start to finish. 714 packages, 18 seconds, exit 0.
sf --version and sf plugins --core immediately after install. The agent plugin is already there at 1.45.0 as a core plugin — nothing to install separately.
Akamai's Access Denied page, served to a headless Chromium asking for developer.salesforce.com/signup.
The same script run headless and headed, back to back: 403 then 200. The only difference between the runs is the headless flag.
The Developer Edition signup form as it arrives. Six fields, one agreement, and a marketing opt-in that disappears when the country is set to the UK.
The same form, filled and valid — every field carrying its green tick, the Main Services Agreement checked. Email redacted for publication.
Forty seconds after clicking Sign me up. The fields have greyed out, the button reads Please wait.., and it never stops reading Please wait.. Email redacted for publication.
What the page was actually doing while it said Please wait: no request sent, an invisible reCAPTCHA loaded but never initialised, navigator.webdriver true.
